欢迎使用中文或英文填写，无需同时翻译。 / Fill this out in Chinese or English; no translation into both languages is required.

## 提交前 / Before submitting
- [ ] 已搜索已有建议 / I searched existing requests.
- [ ] 已确认内容与附件可以公开分享 / My content and attachments are safe to share publicly.

## 使用场景与问题 / Use case and problem
你在什么工作流中遇到了什么困难？目前如何处理？
What workflow are you using, what problem do you face, and how do you handle it today?

## 希望的体验 / Proposed solution
描述你希望 Sonic Vein Studio 如何工作，以及这能带来什么帮助。
Describe how you would like Sonic Vein Studio to work and how that would help.

## 替代方案 / Alternatives considered
是否考虑过其他操作方法或设计？
What alternative workflows or designs have you considered?

## 影响范围 / Impact
谁会从中受益？发生频率和重要程度如何？
Who would benefit, how often does this come up, and how important is it to your workflow?

## 补充信息 / Additional context
可提供应用版本、运行环境、示意图或参考案例。请勿上传密钥、未公开源码或未经授权的素材。
Include the app version, environment, mockups or references if helpful. Do not upload keys, private source code or materials you are not authorized to share.

> 提交建议不代表实现或发布时间承诺。使用求助与开放讨论也欢迎前往 Discussions。
>
> Submitting a request does not guarantee implementation or a release date. For help and open-ended conversations, please use Discussions.
